# githubevent

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/pkg/controller/observers/githubevent"
```

Package githubevent re\-exports the githubevent\-observer reconciler type as a public alias. The reconciler itself stays in internal/controller/observers/githubevent, unchanged; this package exists only so that external test modules have a valid, non\-internal import path to construct it against.

<a name="Reconciler"></a>
## type Reconciler

Reconciler observes GitHubEvent CRs and their Argo Events Sensor, deriving and writing the event's accepted/triggered/success status.

```go
type Reconciler = internalgithubevent.Reconciler
```
